easyPrerequisites: Fleet Swallower does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Declare Fleet Swallower as an attacker.
When Fleet Swallower attacks, it triggers, causing the player Fraying Sanity is attached to to mill half their library, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Fraying Sanity triggers, causing that player to mill cards equal to the number of cards put into their graveyard this turn.
